scope: Unseen-paper validation of Gerloff (2021): three 1 MW electrolysis foreground systems, exact operating and manufacturing-energy inventory, grouped capital-component coverage, and representative detailed capital quantities reported only inside supplementary embedded figures.
benchmark_design_notes: The source-facing fixtures deliberately mirror the current application's text extraction: PDF text plus machine-readable DOCX paragraphs/tables. The supplementary Figures 1-5 are embedded images and are therefore absent from the source fixture under the current DOCX ingestion path.

The gold standard nevertheless includes 30 representative quantities from those embedded supplementary figures. This is intentional: the first blind run should reveal whether image-only LCI is lost by the current end-to-end ingestion path rather than silently granting the extractor OCR-derived text it would not receive in the application.

Capital equipment names are treated as component/stage information within the three technology foreground systems, not as independent foreground production processes, to avoid redundant Brightway searches for each physical item.
